name: universal-ai-video-studio
description: Local-first AI video production studio with Remotion and Three.js.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run validate && npm run timing -- projects/sample/project.json
scripts.render:scenes: npm run prepare:render && tsx scripts/render-scenes.ts projects/sample/project.json
scripts.render:draft: npm run prepare:render && remotion render src/index.tsx UniversalVideoStudio out/draft.mp4 --props=.tmp/render-props.json --gl=swangle --scale=0.5
scripts.render:final: npm run prepare:render && remotion render src/index.tsx UniversalVideoStudio out/final.mp4 --props=.tmp/render-props.json --gl=swangle
scripts.render:still: npm run prepare:render && remotion still src/index.tsx UniversalVideoStudio out/draft-frame.png --props=.tmp/render-props.json --frame=80 --gl=swangle --scale=0.5
